passages.note: Bill status page shows Mesnard as prime sponsor of the omnibus taxation bill SB 1828, signed by the Governor and chaptered as Chapter 412.
Senate Third Reading shows Mesnard voting Aye on the amended omnibus taxation bill, passed 16-14.

The enacted chapter text shows SB 1828 bundles unrelated tax provisions — a higher unemployment-insurance taxable wage base, an income-tax-rate-cut trigger mechanism, a lower class one property assessed-valuation ratio, and new tax credits — confirming the bill is multi-subject.

rows.reasoning: SB 1828 (2021) is titled 'omnibus; taxation' and combines unrelated provisions in one vote — raising the unemployment-insurance taxable wage base, cutting individual income tax rates, lowering the class one property assessed-valuation ratio, and adding new tax credits — so Mesnard's sponsorship and Aye vote are multi-subject under V4.1 and cannot be tied to any single rung's clause absent his own words explaining the vote. No statement in these sources ties his action to a specific provision, so no passage establishes even a direction.
